sources.endpoint: specimen with a recorded preanalytical nonconformance
sources.opportunity: specimen assessed in the published six-month hospital census
sources.modifications: Selected monthly success/failure counts, original machine labels, typed JSON; no prose or source table layout reproduced.
limitations: Composite workflow endpoint; do not interpret all nonconformances as an individual human error.
Only monthly aggregates are available publicly; individual records require author access and were not acquired.
No operator/crew dependence, patient mix, recovery pairing or individual prediction timing can be verified.
Monthly, department and category tables describe the same population and must not be pooled as independent trials.
Success means no recorded nonconformance under the source checks, not proof that every underlying action was correct.
